metadata.description: Tools for explaining code and communicating engineering work to reviewers, new hires, and stakeholders.

plugins.name: explain-code
plugins.description: Explain code — a change, a feature, a module, or a whole codebase — as a self-contained HTML page with a test-first gate, brief-by-default sections, and a shuffled quiz.

plugins.name: improvement-plan
plugins.description: Draft a layered, plain-English improvement plan for non-technical or mixed audiences that orders interventions cheapest-first and ends with explicit stakeholder asks.

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Remove signs of AI-generated writing from text (em-dash overuse, rule-of-three, promotional language, AI vocabulary, filler, hedging) so prose reads as natural and human. Sourced live from blader/humanizer (MIT), pinned to v2.9.1; pairs with improvement-plan as a final language pass.

plugins.name: microworld
plugins.description: Build a scrubbable, self-contained HTML micro-world simulation that teaches how a system in the repo actually works, grounded in its real code and recorded numbers -- with a verification harness and a self-improving learnings log.
